description: Rules for computing the dominant pain axis from detected patterns in a session.

repetition_bonus.description: Applied when a pattern has been detected more than once in the session

tie_break.description: When two axes score equally, prefer the axis whose patterns have the highest individual severity rating
tie_break.secondary_description: If severity is also equal, prefer the axis whose patterns have the highest confidence score
tie_break.fallback_description: If all strategies yield a tie, default to comparison axis

fields.confidence: float [0.0, 1.0] — model certainty that this pattern is present
fields.severity: integer [1, 5] — reported or inferred intensity of the pattern

axis_aggregation.description: All pattern_scores belonging to the same pain_axis are summed to produce the axis_score

scoring_example.description: Session with three detected patterns, two on the same axis

result.reasoning: comparison axis scored 6.90 vs self_doubt 3.28; repetition bonus on comparison_01 amplified the gap
